classification.difficultyReason: Plan a sequence of sine-rule and angle-sum calculations to obtain an included angle or missing side before applying the area rule.

content.prompt: Find the area of each of the triangles shown below, correct to two decimal places:

spec.description: Unfilled triangle with horizontal base, left sloping side labelled 4 cm and base angles 64° and 39°. No vertex names are printed.
spec.mathematics: The apex angle is 77°. Coordinates derive from the given side and angles.

answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the base length in centimetres and $\alpha$ the apex angle.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=180^\circ-64^\circ-39^\circ\\\alpha&=77^\circ\\\frac{x}{\sin77^\circ}&=\frac{4}{\sin39^\circ}\\x&=\frac{4\sin77^\circ}{\sin39^\circ}\\\text{Area}&=\frac12\times4\times\frac{4\sin77^\circ}{\sin39^\circ}\times\sin64^\circ\\\text{Area}&\approx11.13\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled triangle with horizontal base, right sloping side labelled 5 m and base angles 41° and 76°.
spec.mathematics: The apex angle is 63°. Coordinates derive from the given side and angles.

answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the base length in metres and $\alpha$ the apex angle.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=180^\circ-41^\circ-76^\circ\\\alpha&=63^\circ\\\frac{x}{\sin63^\circ}&=\frac{5}{\sin41^\circ}\\x&=\frac{5\sin63^\circ}{\sin41^\circ}\\\text{Area}&=\frac12\times5\times\frac{5\sin63^\circ}{\sin41^\circ}\times\sin76^\circ\\\text{Area}&\approx16.47\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unfilled triangle with horizontal base labelled 6 km, right sloping side labelled 4 km and apex angle 85°.
spec.mathematics: The left base angle satisfies sin(alpha)=4 sin(85°)/6. Its supplementary value is impossible with the given apex angle.

answer.short:
$9.63\text{ km}^2$

Use the sine rule to find a base angle, then the area rule.
answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the left base angle and $\beta$ the right base angle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin\alpha}{4}&=\frac{\sin85^\circ}{6}\\\sin\alpha&=\frac{4\sin85^\circ}{6}\\\alpha&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{4\sin85^\circ}{6}\right)\\\beta&=180^\circ-85^\circ-\alpha\\\text{Area}&=\frac12\times6\times4\times\sin\beta\\\text{Area}&\approx9.63\text{ km}^2\end{align*}$$
The supplementary value of $\alpha$ would make the angle sum exceed $180^\circ$. Keep $\alpha$ and $\beta$ unrounded until the final calculation.

spec.description: Unfilled triangle with horizontal base labelled 8 m, left sloping side labelled 5 m and apex angle 94°.
spec.mathematics: The right base angle satisfies sin(beta)=5 sin(94°)/8. Both base angles must be acute because the apex angle is obtuse.

answer.short:
$14.73\text{ m}^2$

Use the sine rule to find a base angle, then the area rule.
answer.worked:
Let $\beta$ be the right base angle and $\alpha$ the left base angle.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin\beta}{5}&=\frac{\sin94^\circ}{8}\\\sin\beta&=\frac{5\sin94^\circ}{8}\\\beta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{5\sin94^\circ}{8}\right)\\\alpha&=180^\circ-94^\circ-\beta\\\text{Area}&=\frac12\times8\times5\times\sin\alpha\\\text{Area}&\approx14.73\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Since the apex angle is obtuse, both base angles are acute. Keep the angles unrounded until the final calculation.
